title: A private-namespace capability is found in the same search as the public ones
rationale: If private capabilities need a different call, organisations cannot put their own work where their agents already look.
controlReason: The customer record exists only inside the Netsi namespace on this machine. An agent without CFCM has no source for it, so condition B cannot succeed by any means — which is the claim OBJ-6 makes, not a performance result.
